instruction: Copy the compressed archive 'data.tar.gz' to each of directories 'dir1', 'dir2', 'dir3'.

parameters.command: rm -rf dir1 dir2 dir3 && rm -f data.tar.gz && echo 'Sample data' > sample.txt && tar -czf data.tar.gz sample.txt && rm sample.txt && mkdir dir1 dir2 dir3

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'for d in dir1 dir2 dir3; do if [ -f "$d/data.tar.gz" ]; then echo "Success: data.tar.gz exists in $d."; else echo "Failure: data.tar.gz does not exist in $d."; fi; done'
